knownDifferences: Code table cell renders c\|d, retaining backslash. Table editing repads table whitespace; text outside the table remains unchanged.

Copying same-named files to child folders inside the original vault resolved the short Renamed.md link to the root target. This diagnostic was not counted as a successful isolated-vault round. Three subsequent independent vaults each contained only the transferred files and passed target navigation.
limitations: Portable migration explicitly copies both Markdown files and the SVG. It does not test or claim an Obsidian Markdown-export command.
Native functional test only; no performance ranking follows.
The fresh vault Mermaid trust prompt remains pending user handling; raw source is preserved.
The initial format reopen closes and reopens a note tab in the same process; independent vault rounds use fresh application processes.
